# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) — Property Marketplace Across India

> BhoomiMitra is an India-focused property marketplace for sale, rent, and lease. Individuals, companies, and agents can submit eligible property listings, while buyers and tenants can contact the listed seller directly. BhoomiMitra currently charges no platform listing fee and 0% platform brokerage.

BhoomiMitra supports plots, homes, commercial spaces, industrial properties, hospitality properties, agricultural land, and related real-estate categories across India. Submitted listings follow platform validation, moderation, and review workflows before approved listings become publicly visible. A listing or review status does not guarantee title, ownership, legality, valuation, or suitability, and buyers should complete independent legal and physical due diligence.

Indian Land Measurement Conversions:
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)

## Key Public Routes

- [Marketplace Homepage](https://bhoomimitra.com/): Property search, marketplace highlights, featured listings, land-area tools, and buyer due-diligence guidance.
- [Find Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Property explorer with category, transaction, location, price, and area filters.
- [Post Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/sell): Property listing creator for eligible Individual, Company, and Agent sellers. Current platform listing fee is ₹0; submitted listings follow the review workflow.
- [About BhoomiMitra](https://bhoomimitra.com/about): Marketplace model, seller types, direct seller contact, and platform fee approach.
- [Customer Support](https://bhoomimitra.com/contact): Customer support and grievance redressal.
- [Listing Rules](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Seller submission standards, declarations, moderation rules, and prohibited listings.
- [Terms of Service](https://bhoomimitra.com/terms): Platform terms, transaction limitations, and liability disclaimers.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/privacy): Data handling, privacy, and account-related information.

## Optional
